data_fields.name: light camera near plane and offset

data_fields.name: caster window along and across the light

best_idea: Pick the shadow-map resolution from the shadowed actor's on-screen size, in power-of-two steps clamped to five levels, and cull shadow casters by a radius cap and a distance window, so a small or distant boss costs a small shadow pass.
decision_why: Boss and hero shadows are a main quality cost on a phone and this rule scales them with the camera; take the apparent-size resolution, the caster cap and window and the depth padding; fix the along-ray bound, the zero-size guard and the apparent-size unit, and add a per-zone caster cap.
acceptance: On a 375-wide world zone, the boss shadow map steps down through 2048, 1024 and 512 as the camera pulls back to three set distances (dev overlay shows the size), at most one shadow pass per shadowed actor per frame, and a unit test asserts inShadowCylinder is false for a caster 1200 units along the light and shadowLod(2048, 0) returns level 4.
